description: Stormwater Network at City of Port Adelaide Enfield is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Port Adelaide Enfield Council. Stormwater Network at City of Port Adelaide Enfield. 4 map layers comprising of Conduits, Connectors and Wetlands. This data is presented through the Council's own website for open geospatial data. Formats available are SHP, KML, GeoJson and WMS. (all in geographic latitude and longitude except the Shapefile which is GDA 1994 MGA Zone 54). Coverage: Port Adelaide Enfield Council. The portal files it under the publisher Port Adelaide Enfield Council. Its tags are council, drainage, infrastructure, port adelaide enfield, stormwater. It offers 5 resource(s) in MIXED SPATIAL FORMATS, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
